error.description: Error is the tool's error, when the call failed.

items.description: Write is a side-effecting tool call (intercepted in dry-run).

write.description:
Write is whether the tool can change things (not read-only): such
calls are intercepted in dry runs, and are also listed in Writes.

error.description: Error is the tool's error, when the call failed.

items.description: Call is one tool call a run made.

calls.description:
Calls are every tool call, in order (absent in records from before
they were kept).

costUsd.description:
CostUSD is the run's cost at API list prices: claude-api runs only (agent CLI
runs are on the CLI's own plan, and the app never works out a cost for them).

output.description:
Output is the result in the shape the routine declared (Dotprompt
output: schema), validated; absent for routines without one.

outcome.description:
Outcome is the routine's own report when the run succeeded: done or
nothing_to_do (a failed report fails the run). Reason says why.

kind.description: Kind is program for a program; absent for an LLM routine (llm).

exitCode.description: ExitCode is the code it exited with (-1 when it was killed).

summary.description: Summary is the line it wrote to $PA_RESULT, if it wrote one.

output.description:
Output is what it printed (stdout and stderr): all of it, or its first
and last 32 KiB with what was left out marked between them.

outputTruncated.description: OutputTruncated is true when it printed more than Output holds.

checksum.description: Checksum is the SHA-256 of the executable that ran.

program.description: Program is a program's run: its exit code, summary and output.

title: procauto hooks fire --json
description: RunOutput is `run --json`: how the run went.
